description: GLAMOUR (GLobAl building MOrphology dataset for URban climate modelling) gives building height and building surface fraction at 100-metre resolution for urban centres worldwide. It was published on Zenodo on 2 February 2024 by Ruidong Li of Tsinghua University and Ting Sun of University College London. Tiles named by longitude and latitude bounds hold building height (BH_100m) and building footprint (BF_100m), where footprint means surface fraction, the share of plan area covered by buildings. Estimates come from TensorFlow models applied to Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 imagery and NASADEM and Copernicus elevation models retrieved through Google Earth Engine, masked with the World Settlement Footprint 2019; the scripts for defining regions, downloading, predicting and post-processing are included. Coverage: global urban centres. Access: GeoTIFF tiles and code on Zenodo; the concept DOI groups versions. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: machine-learning estimates at 100 metres, not individual buildings. Simulation uses: urban canopy parameters for urban climate and heat models and gridded exposure. Related records: WUDAPT-style morphology datasets, GlobalBuildingAtlas and the EU building density map.
